dream_light_growth: The hot summer afternoon becomes a fire lit on a July day: the roaring hearth is the key, and the real afternoon sun is only a hazy glow at the door and the smoked windows (environment fixed.dream_growth; architecture grows_from: the family range turned open hearth).
natural_light_logic: Per architecture interior.openings: the front door and two small smoked leaded windows are on the south wall, the hearth on the west end wall, one small half-shuttered high window on the north wall. With the sun due west (az about 268), the south door gets no square-on beam, only a glancing raking sliver at the jamb and the bright glare of the sunlit yard; the smoke turns this into a soft pale glow. The north high window gives dim sky light only. No direct sun reaches the floor.

schemes.key_bearing: from the open hearth centred on the west end wall, about 0.5-1.5 m above the floor, raking along the room
schemes.fill: pale smoky daylight glow from the open south door and the two smoked windows beside it; dim sky light from the high north window; everything else lost in pepper-smoke
practicals: open hearth fire under the brick arch (west wall)
fire glow under the black cauldron on its crane
schemes.secondary_color_temp: daylight glow at the door reads neutral-cool (~5000K) against the fire
schemes.quality: flickering orange firelight, bloom and haze in thick grey-brown smoke that lifts the blacks and swallows the far walls; hard fire-lit edges near the hearth, soft murk beyond
schemes.prompt_fragment_en: smoke-filled low kitchen lit mainly by a roaring open hearth fire, flickering warm orange firelight raking low from one end of the room, thick grey-brown pepper-smoke catching the glow and blurring the far walls, a pale hazy daylight glow from the open door and small smoked windows, dim murky corners, no direct sunlight inside
schemes.reason: The fire, cauldron and smoke are explicit (ch006-p19 'full of smoke from one end to the other', 'leaning over the fire'); the light plan, openings logic and colour are designed. Enclosed interior with a fire as key, so no daylight-level exposure inside (visual-qa rule).
